description: Sets a property or calls a method on a node, or on an engine singleton nodePath names, in the running game. A call that takes longer than timeoutMs is not cancelled: the answer is pending with a requestId, and op result collects it. Operations: set (needs nodePath, property, value): set a property; call (needs nodePath, method): call a method and return its result; result (needs requestId): collect the reply to any runtime_* call that answered pending, by its requestId.

args.description: The arguments, fitted to the parameter types. An object parameter takes a path to one the game holds, "/root/Main/Hud", or a resource's res:// path. Another engine object is {"_type": its class, and its properties}. For op call.

method.description: The method, or a colon path through what a node holds, "_game:run:advance". Change a list or map with set. A 2D physics query is "get_world_2d():direct_space_state:intersect_point". For op call.

nodePath.description: Node path such as "/root/Main/Player", a unique name such as "%Player", or an engine singleton such as Engine, Performance, Time or PhysicsServer2D. call: also a class_name or res:// path, for a static function. Not for op result.

projectPath.description: Which game, when several run: its project folder.

properties.description: Read the object the call answered with under result_properties: true for every variable its script declares, or a list of colon paths. For op call.

property.description: The property to write. A colon path goes through what a node holds, "_game:run:day", "_game:run:roster:0:name" or "position:x". Steps are as runtime_inspect property describes. For op set.

requestId.description: The requestId a pending answer gave. For op result.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait before answering pending with a requestId. Default 10000. Not for op result.

value.description: The value, fitted to the property's type. Vectors are {"x": 140, "y": 300}, a colour may be "#ff8000", an enum takes its name or number. An object property takes a path to one the game holds, or the text null to empty it, and a resource its res:// path. For op set.

name: runtime_invoke
title: Set or call in the running game
